summary: Declaration audit of the q3a4 causal/noncausal reason fork: the essential-principles sense is represented by a primitive field, whereas the third sense is linked to Leibnizian explanation of the whole contingent series. Reject field wrappers, self-causation identification without a bridge, and defining explanatory adequacy by absence of efficient causes. No declarations, proof types, claims, or allowances changed. The existing conditional external-cause transcription and its omission controls are retained unchanged.
blocker: Coordinator must select series-level versus a new individual-level analyst sense and specify explanatory adequacy and its relation to efficient causation. Essential efficient sufficiency also needs a body distinguishing principles from agent self-causation; the existing Profile does not supply that structure. No premise is discharged.
label: Q3a4 essential efficient sufficiency and whole-series reason declaration blockers
